scope: Old228 versus expanded868 data, existing frozen-vision ObjectAug/cold_mix architecture only; no closed-loop or architecture changes

data.two_failed_setup_episodes: Retained in train with actual all-table labels; intended state kind is reporting metadata, never a model input
data.heldout: New A/B family-disjoint combination:>=2In and every object In or Held. Test payload inaccessible before model freeze. No C/D.

comparison.baseline: Reuse sealed M cold_mix seeds0,1 step1500, not continued finetuning
comparison.new: Two new fits from exact matching initializations, seeds0,1;1500 updates each
comparison.sampling: Per microbatch4 old four-step core +4 six-step. Keep original core IDs, crop-start schedule and sequence lengths. Expand six-step pool108->748. No uniform868 claim. Same24000 draws and89834/89839 effective transitions per seed.
comparison.normalization: Original old-training-only geometry means/std and class weights unchanged
comparison.encoder: Existing DINO and CELL learned encoder per seed frozen; old228 and old78 cached features reused exactly. New boundary-only causal four-frame dual-camera cache, fresh visible registry per episode, no probe-window insertion
comparison.selection: Fixed step1500 only; no checkpoint or threshold selection, no planned hyperparameter repairs

evaluation.thresholds: Held/In0.5;drawer argmax; masks exclude invalid labels from denominators
evaluation.primary: Cold initial relations at every nonterminal origin; h0 and middle separately. Complete observed-path state and one-step from origin0. Free1/3/5 and full6 from cold origins. Held/In TP,FP,positive/negative denominators; joint Held3+In3+drawer on fully valid states. Shared GT-stable non-target In and Held intervals, both-correct and prior-correct forgetting denominators.
evaluation.heldout_subset: Report all test conditions AND conditions whose actual target state satisfies frozen>=2In/allInOrHeld combination. Eligibility from labels only after model/metric freeze, no outcome-driven replacement.
evaluation.strata: Prepared state kind, actual initial relation, environment, requested skill, nominal/miss/order branch, color and horizon; report exact eligible denominators and two seeds separately.
evaluation.single_item_diagnostic: For middle origins on development only, replace zero recurrent prior with existing causal public-prefix prior. Same current window, model, actions and future targets. No GT initializer; no fitting. Diagnose earliest initial-versus-transition error, not repair individual cases.
evaluation.uncertainty: If bootstrap used, paired resampling by layout family,2000 draws fixed seed; not independent windows or extra training-seed evidence
